calculation_handling.description: If lawfully existing buildings on a lot exceed the permitted maximum floor space index, their lawful FSI becomes the maximum FSI for those buildings.
calculation_handling.gaps: The clause sets the limit to the as-built value of a lawfully existing building but names no date, so it cannot be written with existing(variable; date) without inventing one; keyed UNUSUAL (conservative) rather than as a LIMIT.

units.disclosure: Existing buildings lawfully built above today's floor space index may keep that floor area; we cannot check existing floor area.

10.5.40.41(1).explanation: If existing buildings on a lot were lawfully built with more floor area than the current floor space index allows, that existing floor space index is treated as the maximum for those buildings.
